model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers under three gating conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03" is represented by a blue dashed line without markers; it begins at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, drops sharply to roughly 0.04 by layer 2, and maintains a steady, near-zero trend, ending near 0.0 at layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.98 at layer 0, declines steadily to about 0.47 at layer 7, and drops to roughly 0.29 at layer 10. It then fluctuates, with notable peaks at layer 19 (approximately 0.28) and layer 21 (approximately 0.40), ending at roughly 0.39 at layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33" is depicted by a green dash-dot line without markers. It begins at 1.0 at layer 0, declines to about 0.36 at layer 7, and continues downward to approximately 0.19 at layer 10. It then gradually decreases with minor fluctuations, including a small peak near 0.11 at layer 21, concluding at approximately 0.04 at layer 23.
